Strategy: Reward bins that stay roomy enough for two more items of the same size after placement, keeping big reserves for repeated items. It may help when items repeat in runs, but may fail by hoarding loose bins that later items cannot use.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= 2 * item and r - item < 3 * item else 0) for r in bins]
```
